name: ATM Withdrawal Response V 03
definition: The ATMWithdrawalResponse message is sent by an acquirer or its agent to an ATM in response to the ATMWithdrawalRequest to inform the ATM of the approval or decline of the withdrawal transaction.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMWithdrawalResponse.name: ATM Withdrawal Response
ATMWithdrawalResponse.definition: Information related to the response of an ATM withdrawal transaction from an ATM manager.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC.
